name: Pasted text
headline: This copy carries the page's address.

findings.sentence: The browser added the page's address to this copy: https://gemini.google.com/u/0/app/0000000000000000?pageId=none. Apps like Word and OneNote can keep it when you paste.
The copy carries an ID from the page that looks like a response ID: model-response-message-contentr_0000000000000000.
The copy carries the page's own styling (5 class names, 24 inline styles), which can hint at the site it came from.
